name: Prosthetic Joint Infection
definition: Infection involving a joint prosthesis and adjacent tissues, presenting acutely or chronically with pain, swelling, drainage or implant dysfunction.

investigations.principle: Inflammatory markers, aspiration for cell count/culture and imaging are integrated using accepted PJI criteria.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Debridement, one-stage or two-stage revision depends on timing, organism, implant stability and host factors.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhi-Shotha framework is secondary to modern infection eradication.

patientEducation.summary: Infection involving a joint prosthesis and adjacent tissues, presenting acutely or chronically with pain, swelling, drainage or implant dysfunction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
